Name: Avoid floating point data types
Description: Floating point (Double) data types can cause precision issues. Use Decimal for financial columns.

Name: Visible measure missing format string
Description: Every visible measure must define an explicit FormatString.

Name: Avoid bi-directional relationships
Description: Bi-directional cross-filtering causes ambiguity and degrades query performance; keep pure 1:* single-direction star schemas.

Name: Hide foreign key columns
Description: Surrogate/foreign key columns on the many side of relationships must be hidden from report authors.

Name: Disable default summarization on numeric columns
Description: Numeric columns should have SummarizeBy set to None to prevent implicit aggregation.
Expression: IsVisible and SummarizeBy <> "None" and (DataType = "Double" or DataType = "Decimal" or DataType = "Int64")

Name: Avoid division operator (use DIVIDE)
Description: Use DIVIDE() instead of the / operator to handle division by zero safely.
Expression: Tokenize().Any(Type = DIV and Next.Type <> INTEGER_LITERAL and Next.Type <> REAL_LITERAL)

Name: RLS table permission has empty filter expression
Description: Security role table permissions must never leave FilterExpression empty (fail-closed RLS policy).

Name: Column references must be fully qualified
Description: Always reference columns as 'Table'[Column] so columns are clearly distinguished from measures.

Name: Measure references must be unqualified
Description: Reference measures as bare [Measure] without a table prefix.

Name: Visible measure missing description
Description: Every visible measure should document its business intent in Description.

Name: Measure description exceeds 200 characters
Description: Keep measure descriptions concise (<= 200 characters) per Enterprise BI standards.

Name: Visible measure missing display folder
Description: Organize visible measures into DisplayFolder groups.

Name: Disable IsAvailableInMDX on hidden non-hierarchy columns
Description: Hidden columns not used in hierarchies, sort-by, or variations should disable IsAvailableInMDX.
Expression: not IsVisible and IsAvailableInMDX and not UsedInHierarchies.Any() and not UsedInVariations.Any() and not UsedInSortBy.Any()

Name: Avoid IFERROR in DAX expressions
Description: IFERROR can mask upstream model errors and inhibit storage engine optimizations.

Name: Avoid FILTER(ALL(...)) pattern
Description: Avoid FILTER(ALL(...)) inside iterators or CALCULATE; prefer direct boolean column filters or KEEPFILTERS.
